decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 2 Eversley Crescent.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the south wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - It is considered that this application for the erection of a two storey side 
           extension and the creation of habitable rooms in the roof space and a 
           single storey rear and flank extension to the existing house, 
           2 Eversley Crescent, because of the position, design and appearance of the            extensions, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of            this property and would not be detrimental to the appearance of the original           dwellinghouse and the character of the street scene, to the amenities of the           adjoining and neighbouring  properties or the character of the area.  The           development is in accordance with the UDP policies  ENV-B.1.1 (New Development),            H.6.4  (Extensions and Alterations) and T 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing           facilities for Developments) of  The London Borough of  Hounslow UDP, Adopted           December 2003;  and is  compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a 2 storey side & single storey rear extension to existing house. (AMENDED PLANS RECEIVED)
